children: VenHub Global entered into a $100 million Equity Purchase Agreement with Euphoria Capital, providing discretionary access to equity financing over a period of up to 24 months. The company may deliver daily put notices, with purchases priced at 97% of the average three-day VWAP and capped by daily volume and a 4.99% ownership limit; VenHub will also issue 800,000 commitment shares. Separately, the company signed a Registration Rights Agreement requiring it to file an SEC registration statement within 30 days to cover resales of shares issued under the facility. The arrangements are designed to enhance financial flexibility while observing Nasdaq share issuance limitations pending required shareholder approval.
